answer: Mechanism: delayed-VRF zone lottery. Agents commit handles before each epoch; a threshold-BLS beacon is revealed only after commitments close. A VRF maps each handle to a task zone—river, wharf, or knoll. Sybils cannot precompute or steer placement, so capturing a target zone requires many independent lottery wins. Attacker cost: per-handle registration CPU plus enough identities to overcome hypergeometric odds, with no strategic clustering discount.
